title: Input determined by the configuration code
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, and let $x,x'$ be Boolean strings each of length $n$. For configurations $c$ of $M$ on input $x$ and $c'$ of $M$ on input $x'$, equality of their configuration codes implies $x=x'$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
$c'$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x'$
the two configuration codes are equal
